name: @grokdesk/desktop
description: Grok Desk — hand Grok the goal, find the result on your desk. Desktop workspace for SuperGrok.

scripts.release-qa: vitest run --passWithNoTests src/renderer/lib/release-qa-gate.test.ts src/renderer/lib/motion-system.test.ts src/renderer/lib/lazy-preview-load.test.ts src/renderer/lib/view-transition.test.ts src/renderer/ui-structure.test.ts
scripts.pack: pnpm run build && node scripts/rebuild-native-for-electron.mjs && electron-builder --dir --config.mac.notarize=false --config.mac.identity=null --config.win.signAndEditExecutable=false
scripts.dist: pnpm run build && node scripts/rebuild-native-for-electron.mjs && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run build && node scripts/rebuild-native-for-electron.mjs && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run build && node scripts/rebuild-native-for-electron.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never --config.npmRebuild=false --config.win.signAndEditExecutable=false && node scripts/rebuild-native-for-electron.mjs
scripts.dist:mac:unlocked: GROKDESK_BAKE_DEV_UNLOCK=1 pnpm run build && node scripts/rebuild-native-for-electron.mjs && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never --config.mac.notarize=false --config.mac.identity=null
scripts.dist:win:unlocked: GROKDESK_BAKE_DEV_UNLOCK=1 pnpm run build && node scripts/rebuild-native-for-electron.mjs --platform win32 --arch x64 && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never --config.npmRebuild=false --config.win.signAndEditExecutable=false && node scripts/rebuild-native-for-electron.mjs
scripts.e2e:chat: pnpm run build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts e2e/chat-delivery.spec.ts e2e/chat-recovery.spec.ts e2e/chat-approvals.spec.ts e2e/chat-experience.spec.ts
